name: godot-topdown
description: A Godot 4 2D top-down game through make-game, judged by the bots playing it through engine-godot's driver, the Godot gates (project, self-test, export) and the playtest.

input.brief: A Godot 2D top-down game: a knight explores a walled garden, collects 6 gems and avoids two patrolling slimes; the game is won when every gem is collected.
